deviations.claimedBehavior: The monthly summary shows the most recent month first; the first row is the current month.
deviations.currentBehavior: getPeriods() builds the six months as currentMonth - i for i = 0..5 (already most-recent-first), then calls periods.reverse(), which yields OLDEST month first; the first row is the oldest of the six months, not the current month.

deviations.claimedBehavior: Statistics loads tasks for the top 5 stages (the five most active stages).
